The arena will be divided into four blue quadrants, each with a different knockback arrow direction. The knockback is approximately half the long vertical of the arena. Players will need to position to avoid being knocked into the wall (by being pushed along the vertical) or use knockback immune.

A telegraphed wide AoE that now hits to the sides and behind (leaving the front safe). A purple line will begin connecting the five nodes starting from the northwest or northeast, indicating the order in which they will resolve an AoE. Each node will also be given a green indicator: A plus indicates a plus-shaped AoE (Pathocross Purge) originating from the node, and a circle indicates a donut AoE (Pathocircuit Purge) originating from the node. Players must pay attention to the green indicator and dodge the AoEs in the order they resolve, as they have late ground telegraphs. During the last set of AoEs, the boss will begin casting another Immune Response (front or side/rear cleave).

Telegraphed AoE tankbuster (Disinfection) and a stack marker on a random player. The tank should stay out while the other players stack together. The order is: Node 1 > Node 2 + Immune Response > Node 3 > Node 4 > Node 5 > Immune Response Using Sprint is recommended.

After the AoEs resolve, each player is given a spread AoE marker (Electray) that deals magical damage and inflicts lightning resistance down Lightning Resistance Down II, making overlap lethal.

During this sequence, players will need to dodge donut AoEs from the Elimbit and line AoEs from the Elimination Claw which have the same indicators as before. Later on, the Elimbit will reappear and use a telegraphed line AoE (Light of Salvation) hitting all players, so the party should spread. There will be another line stack marker as well although it is possible to skip this with enough DPS.

Pulls all players to the middle of the room. Spawns green arrows in different directions on the arena tiles (except for the middle 4 squares), purple X symbols on three corners, and a blue O symbol on one corner tile. Each player will receive link= Greatest Curse that lasts for 15s. They must cleanse this debuff before it naturally expires or they will instantly die. To cleanse the debuff, players must use the green arrows to transport them to the corner O tile. Touching the X tiles will inflict poison poison, dealing high damage-over-time. The symbols will disappear after the mechanic resolves. The easiest way to solve this is to locate the blue O tile corner work backwards, following the arrows that point to it until they reach the center of the room to find the safe path. Once you have reached the blue O tile, you may safely return to the center of the labyrinth and start attacking the boss once more, without waiting for the maze to disappear.

Spawns a floating head above each player's location. After a few seconds, the head will drop from its spawn location (in a small late telegraphed circle AoE) and inflict File:Benoggined icon.png Benoggined for 10s, preventing anyone hit from taking actions and decreasing movement speed. Move away from the heads when they spawn to avoid.

Summons several dolls around the arena.

The dolls will begin running through the arena, aiming at certain players. Once each doll reaches the other side, it will run through the arena a second time. Anyone who touches them will be inflicted with bind for 5s, making them vulnerable to subsequent avoidable AoEs, and then inflicted with File:Benoggined icon.png Benoggined for 10s. This attack is combined with other mechanics throughout the fight, causing a very chaotic sequence of dodging multiple AoEs and dolls at once. The first time the dolls move, they will aim for the furthest player from them. The second time they move, they will aim for the closest player. Two ranged players can bait the dolls by standing near the north and south side of the arena, then move clockwise to dodge until the dolls reach the opposite wall. The dolls should aim for them again, so they can now dodge towards the middle of the arena.

Four exaflare AoE telegraphs will spawn in the middle, 90 degrees away from each other. This is followed by another set of exaflares in the previously empty areas. Wait for the first set of exaflares to go off twice then move into the spawn locations of the first set. Note that these AoEs resolve while the dolls are still running around, so it is important to not touch them.

A ghost appears, tethers, and possesses one teacup. Afterward, all of the tea cups will begin spinning multiple times, moving inwards and outwards to attempt to disorient players. Players must keep track of the originally tethered teacup during this sequence because it will explode as a large late telegraphed AoE (Tricksome Treat).

Now spawns eight teacups, two per cardinal. Tea Awhirl: Two teacups will now be possessed by ghosts. Similar to before, players must keep track of where the possessed teacups end up because both of them will explode. The two tethered teacups will either be 90 or 180 degrees apart, so the final set of AoEs will also spawn in the safe offset. An easy solution to this mechanic is to observe just the first teacup (if possessed cups are next to each other) or any of them if they are on opposite sides. When the cups start to stop go 90 degrees ahead of the observed cup (where another, safe cup will be present) on the edge of the encounter area.

Spawns 13 teacups, nine on the cardinals/center and four on the intercardinals. Kettles will appear over some cups and begin pouring a purple liquid into them, causing them to overflow and create an expanding puddle AoE. While these expand, more cups will be filled and overflow to create more puddles, followed by the remaining cups. Anyone who contacts a puddle will receive damage (Mad Tea Party) and be inflicted with bleeding damage-over-time for 15s. Players should stand near the cups to be filled last and move into the previous puddle locations when they disappear. The boss will use Last Drop, a telegraphed magical tankbuster, during this.
is repeated again and functions similarly to its second incarnation. However, the ghosts will now tether two teacups on opposite cardinals.

This will be combined with a Bitter Regret from the boss itself, leaving the middle or sides safe after the last set of smaller line AoEs.
